about: Voices for singer source 'svs' (engine/svs.py). Pick one with "voice": "<id>". Descriptions, measurements and auditions: docs/voice/VOICES.md. Every voice here is licence-clean for Spectre's CC BY 4.0 tracks only with the credit line given; never use a Lotte V voice in a track with a political subject. The male voices (bank soulx-vocalset) are another kind of model (engine/svs_soulx.py) and carry a `status` note until the owner approves them.

soulx-vocalset.licence: SoulX-Singer: Apache 2.0, code and model weights ('free to use the codes and model weights'); its usage disclaimer asks to respect consent and not to impersonate individuals without authorization. Own vocoder inside the weights (no Potluck). Prompt recordings: VocalSet, CC BY 4.0 (any use, commercial included, with attribution). No ban on AI-generated music or on political subjects in either. Open point for the owner: the VocalSet singers are anonymous professionals who recorded for a research dataset; CC BY covers the recording, not a singer's personality rights, and nobody asked them about voice cloning.
soulx-vocalset.credit: Vocals: SoulX-Singer (Soul AI Lab, Apache 2.0, https://github.com/Soul-AILab/SoulX-Singer), voice from a singer of VocalSet (Wilkins, Seetharaman, Wahl, Pardo 2018, https://zenodo.org/records/1193957, CC BY 4.0)
soulx-vocalset.languages_note: the model sings English, Mandarin and Cantonese; only English is wired (CMUdict). No Spanish.

controls.gender: -1..1 (0): formant shift; negative = formants down (darker, larger, older), positive = up (brighter, younger). Measured on hanami: -0.5 F1/F2 617/987 -> 498/1009 Hz. Not a male voice: at -1 an octave down it stays a low female voice (examples/vocals/svs/voices/ctl-hanami-male-fake.mp3).
controls.velocity: 0.5..2 (1): consonant speed; small effect on these banks
controls.mix: a voice entry may give "mix": {mode: weight} instead of "mode" to blend vocal modes (speaker embeddings interpolated)
controls.not available: these banks have no breathiness, tension, voicing or energy controls (their models were trained without them)
controls.lang: "en" (default) or "es" (Hanami only): the language the lyrics are read in. A voice id may set it (hanami-es, hanami-es-soft); a track's `lang` overrides it. Spanish: engine/lang_es.py, docs/voice/languages/es.md
controls.male voices (soulx): the SoulX-Singer voices take none of gender, velocity, inhale, svs_vibrato or lang. Theirs: svs_tune 0..1 (1: a second pass pulls every note's median onto the written pitch; 0: the model's own pitch, 10-60 cents off), svs_steps (16), seed, double.
